source_summary: Ink monochrome Chinese landscape with inscription and seals above; reusable motifs are extracted only from the painted landscape area, excluding calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture.

motifs.name: upper_craggy_mountains
motifs.description: The broad upper band of jagged, layered mountain and hillside forms spanning the left and center, including the large central peak, smaller adjoining ridges, clustered boulders, and pale receding crags.
must_preserve: dry ink contour lines defining crag profiles
cun-style rubbing and textured washes on rock faces
dark crevice accents between overlapping peaks
soft fading edges where mountains dissolve into mist
small lower boulder clusters at the mountain base

motifs.name: right_distant_islets
motifs.description: Small isolated distant rocks or islets floating in the pale empty space to the right of the upper mountains.
must_preserve: subtle scale contrast with the main mountain mass

motifs.name: left_pine_grove
motifs.description: Dense foreground pine cluster at the lower left, with dark horizontal needle masses, thin trunks, and drooping ink strokes.
must_preserve: fine twig lines around the grove
uneven base where pines merge with rocks and ground

motifs.name: central_leafless_trees
motifs.description: Tall central leafless trees with slender vertical trunks and a network of fine bare branches rising in front of the hut area.
must_preserve: fine branching twigs and forked tips
delicate overlap of branches without including the hut walls as part of the motif

motifs.name: right_bamboo_clump
motifs.description: Leafy bamboo and slender saplings on the right side of the central tree group, with arcing stems and clustered narrow leaves.
must_preserve: light-to-dark ink variation in the foliage
airy gaps between leaves and stems

motifs.name: hidden_hut
motifs.description: Small simple hut or pavilion partly concealed among the foreground trees, including its angular roof, rectangular wall lines, doorway/window marks, and adjacent light structural strokes.
must_preserve: partial concealment by nearby trunks while excluding the trunks as separate tree motifs

motifs.name: right_solitary_cliff
motifs.description: Large freestanding rock cliff on the lower right, with a rounded massive face, darker base, and angular cap rocks.
must_preserve: bold outer contour of the cliff mass
dry-brush rock texture and vertical striations
dark wash at the lower cleft
soft blank negative space around the rock

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_shore
motifs.description: Low foreground rocky bank and shoreline ledges across the lower center and left, including scattered boulders, root-like ground lines, and faint horizontal water or shore strokes near the bottom.
must_preserve: uneven ground contour tying the foreground together

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
